full_page.content:
Pg. 10. Handwritten copy of poem "Killarney".
Pg. 11. Continuation of pg. 10.
Pg. 12. Newspaper copy of poem by Moore-his reply that he had forgotten his love for Ireland.
Pg. 13. Newspaper copy of poem, "A Faithful Guide" by Irene West. Newspaper copy of poem, "God and Our Land" by Mary A. Ford.
Pg. 14. Names and addresses of parishioners - Yonkers, n.y.
Pg. 15. Newspaper copy of poem, "Lines" by Robert Emmet in Irsh World Poetry.
Pg. 16. Newspaper copy of poem, "The First Love" in Catholic Bulletin 1914, April 18.
Pg. 17. Newspaper copy of poem, "Dear Little One, How Sweet Thou Art" in Catholic Bulletin, 1914, January 10.
Pg. 18. Handwritten note from Cather ine of Emmerich. From the Passion of Jesus Christ by B1. Anna Cath. Emmerich, "No one has yet seen all this and terror would cleave thy heart asunder, did I not hold it together."
Pg. 19. One name and donation.
